name: horti_get_crop_calendar
description: Retrieves the full crop calendar for a horticulture crop in a specific region. Includes stage-wise milestones (land prep, sowing, vegetative, flowering, harvesting) with recommended dates. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT provide detailed stage advisory. Fails if crop_type is unsupported for the region or location invalid.

name: horti_get_stage_advisory
description: Provides detailed guidance for a specific crop growth stage including input recommendations, best practices, and expected milestones. Advisory varies by crop, stage, and region. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide weather or pest-specific advice. Fails if crop-stage combination is invalid or region unsupported.

name: horti_get_weather_adjusted_advisory
description: Generates advisory adjusted for current weather conditions. Considers rainfall, temperature, and humidity impact on farming activities. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide raw weather data — use weather tools. Fails if location invalid or weather data insufficient.

name: horti_get_pest_advisory
description: Provides pest and disease management advisory for a horticulture crop at a specific stage. Includes prevention, identification, and treatment guidance. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT diagnose specific infestations — it provides general recommendations. Fails if crop-stage mismatch or no pest data available.

name: horti_get_nutrient_advisory
description: Provides nutrient management recommendations including fertilizer type, dosage, and application timing for a crop at a specific stage. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT replace soil health card recommendations. Fails if crop_type unsupported or stage invalid.

name: horti_track_crop_stage
description: Tracks and returns the current estimated crop stage based on sowing date and crop type. Requires session_token (personalized). Does NOT update stage manually. Calculation is approximate and may not reflect actual field conditions. Fails if no sowing record exists or crop_type unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.

name: horti_get_seasonal_plan
description: Generates a full seasonal plan with stage-wise schedule, input requirements, and activity milestones for a horticulture crop. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT guarantee yield. Plan is advisory only. Fails if crop-location-season combination unsupported.

name: horti_resolve_crop_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous crop names to standardized identifiers. Returns possible matches. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide advisory. Fails if input matches no known crops.

name: horti_resolve_location_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous location names for horticulture advisory. Returns possible matches with state/district context. PUBLIC tool. Fails if no matches found.

name: horti_get_next_stage_guidance
description: Returns guidance for the upcoming crop stage based on current stage progression. Includes preparation steps and timing. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT update records. Fails if current stage is 'harvesting' (no next stage) or crop_type invalid.

name: horti_update_crop_stage
description: Manually updates the crop stage for personalized tracking. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate advisory — use horti_get_stage_advisory. Fails if stage transition is invalid (e.g., jumping from sowing to harvesting) or session invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.

new_stage.description: New stage. Must follow valid progression.

name: horti_get_region_specific_calendar
description: Returns a region-optimized crop calendar that accounts for local agro-climatic conditions. More specific than general calendar. PUBLIC tool. Fails if region data unavailable.

name: horti_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about advisory quality. Categories: 'incorrect_advisory', 'outdated_information', 'crop_mismatch', 'weather_conflict', 'missing_guidance'. Must verify advisory first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.

name: horti_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks horticulture advisory grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.
